violation_type.title: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt (26 TAC §746.3501(1))
violation_type.typical_finding: Information obtained throughout the investigation shows that caregivers did not promptly change a child's soiled diaper, resulting in a rash.

finding_variants.text: Information obtained throughout the investigation shows that caregivers did not promptly change a child's soiled diaper, resulting in a rash.
During the investigation it was found that there were times when diapers were not being changed promptly.

This standard was evaluated as part of the investigation and was found to be deficient. Based on interviews with parents, it was determined that several children in care were not promptly changed after soiling their diapers or clothes.
Two children were reported to be sent home in soiled clothing after having a toileting accident.
There was information provided that a child's diaper was not changed in a timely manner before going outside on the playground.
During an investigation, it was determined a child was left in a tight and dirty diaper leading to a diaper rash.
